summary.text: Karla Miller is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 16th Middlesex District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Lorena Betts in a race with no incumbent.
She has run for the legislature before, in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Miller was the Republican nominee for the 16th Middlesex District in 2022, when Democrat Rodney Elliott defeated her in the general election, 65.3 percent to 34.5 percent.
In 2024 she was the Republican nominee for Massachusetts State Senate, 1st Middlesex District, and lost to incumbent Democrat Edward Kennedy, 63.4 percent to 36.3 percent.
